subject: Multicollinearity in occupancy and detection variables

messages.subject: Multicollinearity in occupancy and detection variables
parts:
Hi there,

For the purpose of species occupancy analysis, I collected a series of variables. I will use some of these to account for imperfect detection. My question concerns their multicollinearity. Should/Can I:
1) test for their multicollinearity altogether, or;
2) do it separately for occupancy variables and detection variables, in two different groups?

Thanks in advance
